tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Upload an image or video for a social platform. Returns a public URL that passes the platform media rules, or the problems with fixes. With convert, a fixable file comes back as status "converting": poll get_media until status is "ready" (url set) or "failed". Give the URL to the platform API (image

tools.name: check_media
tools.description: Check a file against a platform without storing it. With convert, also says whether conversion can fix it.

tools.name: get_media
tools.description: Status (converting, ready, failed), URL, expiry and fetch count of an uploaded file.

tools.name: delete_media
tools.description: Delete an uploaded file now (call after the post is published).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_media · Private data: upload_media, check_media, get_media, delete_media · Public sink: upload_media, delete_media · Destructive: delete_media.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_media · Private data: upload_media, check_media, get_media, delete_media · Public sink: upload_media, delete_media · Destructive: delete_media

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
